formula: acos(clamp(dot(S-E,W-E)/(norm(S-E)*norm(W-E)),-1,1))*180/pi; use world x,y,z, anatomical landmarks 11/13/15 and 12/14/16
smoothing: causal timestamp low pass; tau=0.08 s; use same smoothing on Android
method: Per-arm extension=p10(initial and final)-5 deg; flexion=p90(rep minima)+5 deg; ROM=p10(rep ROM)-5 deg; return and bilateral deviation=p90+5 deg. 5-degree margins are engineering allowances, not validated clinical tolerances.
limitations: Estimated 3D person-specific candidate references, not clinical targets. Do not mix with image-plane angles. No technique accuracy claim without held-out labelled validation.
